name: sherpa
description: Composable /frame, /plan, /implement skills — one per layer (macro, step, build) — with adversarial review at every boundary. The user composes the workflow; opt-in /persist for state.

interface.shortDescription: Composable frame, plan, and implement layers
interface.longDescription: Adds opt-in Sherpa skills — /frame (scout, bind a problem contract), /plan (decompose into steps), /implement (build with per-step review) — that the user composes into a workflow. Nothing persists unless you call /persist.
defaultPrompt: Use /frame to shape this fuzzy task.
Use /plan to decompose this into steps.
Use /implement to build the approved plan.
